title: AT&T post-call recap SMS (on hang-up)
goal: Right after a live power-dialer call ends, send ONE recap/info text from the registered number with the current AT&T promos. Fires on hang-up of an ANSWERED call (a real conversation), not on no-answers or voicemails.

deployment.dialer: Wavv power dialer (human on every call)
deployment.status: draft — NOT published. Trigger must be added in the GHL UI (see triggerSetup), then publish.

triggerSetup.note: The connector writes workflow ACTIONS but does NOT persist workflow TRIGGERS (PUT is accepted but triggers stay empty). Add the trigger manually in the GHL UI.
uiSteps: Open the workflow: Automation > Post-Call — Follow-up Text.
Add filter: Call Duration is greater than 0 (so it fires only on ANSWERED calls you actually spoke on — not no-answers/voicemails). This keeps it inside the 'never cold-text scraped numbers' rule.
Optional: cap re-entry so a contact called twice in a day isn't double-texted.
triggerSetup.rejectedAlternatives: Do NOT trigger on wavv-no-answer or wavv-left-voicemail — those are calls with no live conversation, i.e. cold texts to maps-scraped numbers (TCPA exposure, against CLAUDE.md).

compliance.audience: Commercial leads the team just SPOKE TO live (answered call, then hang-up). The call is the consent boundary.
compliance.exclude: No-answer, voicemail, and bad-number calls. Map/scraped numbers are call/door only until a live conversation happens.
compliance.sender: One A2P-registered number. No sender rotation / snowshoeing.
compliance.optOut: GHL auto-appends the opt-out line. Do not add or strip STOP. Honor STOP via the existing STOP workflow.
compliance.frequency: Single text per answered call. Longer nurture is the separate 'Fiber + Phone Promo Drip' workflow.
compliance.a2p: A2P 10DLC on Command is UNCONFIRMED (bundleSid: null as of last check). Verify the Trust Center shows Approved before turning this live, or carriers will filter outbound.
compliance.tcpa: Texting non-consented/DNC = $500-$1,500 per message. Answered-call only.

steps.description: On hang-up of an answered call, send the single recap text with the current promos. GHL appends the opt-out line. No wait step — it goes out right when the call ends.

attributes.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, Patrick w/ AT&T — great talking today! Recap: AT&T Fiber 1 Gig in the $40s, free install, no contract + a $500 Visa reward card. On wireless, add a line from $15/mo & iPhone 17 as low as $4/mo w/ trade-in. Want me to check what you qualify for? Reply YES or call 832-247-4060.

promos.fiber: AT&T Fiber 1 Gig in the $40s, free install, no contract, + $500 Visa reward card
promos.device: iPhone 17 as low as $4/mo with trade-in

replyRouting.yes: Continue booking; hand live calls to 832-247-4060; move opp forward and tag accordingly.
replyRouting.stop: Existing STOP workflow scrubs the contact; never re-text.
replyRouting.noReply: Stop texting; the lead stays in the call/dialer cadence.

confirmationPoints: Confirm A2P 10DLC is Approved before publishing.
Confirm the trigger is Call Status = Completed with Duration > 0 (answered calls only).
Publish only after the trigger is attached in the UI.
output: A single recap SMS to each lead the team spoke with on an answered call, sent from the registered number on hang-up, with replies routed to booking.
